senses.definition: n.m. Ex 15:14 a writhing, anguish;—ח׳ abs. Ex 15:14 + 5 times—
writhing (contortions of fear) Ex 15:14 (‖ vb. רָגַז).

anguish, always in sim. כַּיּוֹלֵדָה ψ 48:7 (allied kings against Jerus.); Zion, before Assyrians Mi 4:9; before Scythians or Chaldeans Je 6:24 (‖ צָרָה), = 50:43 (of king of Babylon; ‖ צָרָה); 22:23 (‖ חבלים q.v.)
